summary: We put 11 range extenders and mesh systems to the test to find the fastest and most reliable for streaming, gaming and working from home• The best office chairsFast fibre broadband is fantastic – if the wifi signal reaches the part of your home where you need it.

stories.title: Show HN: I wrote an entire Vim manual over 4 years
summary: I'm glad to announce that I'm releasing my new book, Learning to Play Vim.When I started using Vim more than a decade ago, I wished there was a manual out there teaching how to use this fantastic editor step by step, beginning with the foundations up to more advanced features.

I also read the entire Vim manual (`:help manual`), but I didn't like it: it was too detailed in places (for example `02.8 Finding help` completely lost me for a while), and other features didn't get the treatment they deserved.So I decided to write my own Vim manual.
